children: US 30-year fixed mortgage rates averaged 6.71% as of September 3rd, 2026, up from 6.66% a week earlier and 6.50% a year ago. “The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaged 6.71% this week,” said Sam Khater, Freddie Mac’s Chief Economist. “Purchase demand has remained relatively stable, indicating steady interest from buyers adapting to evolving market conditions.” Meanwhile, the 15-year fixed mortgage rate averaged 6.04%, up from 5.98% the previous week.

title: US 30-Year Mortgage Rate Rises to 6.71%
